en-US.description: Convert your PDF documents to text with the help of this program. No need to upload your PDF files to online servers. PDF to Text Converter can convert PDF files to TXT files. It also supports drag and drop.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft PDF to Text Converter is a fast, lightweight desktop application that converts PDF (Portable Document Format) files to editable TXT files entirely offline with no uploads to online servers. Built for both beginners and power users, it offers a clean, minimalist interface where every feature is immediately accessible.

PDF is the standard document format developed by Adobe and is widely used for sharing files across different platforms and devices. This program lets you extract and work with the content of these files without needing Adobe Acrobat or any other dedicated PDF reader.

Load multiple PDF files at once by manually browsing, using drag-and-drop, or passing files directly via command line parameters for quick batch processing and automation workflows. Once loaded, all text is automatically extracted and displayed within the main window, ready to read, edit, cut, copy, and paste just like any standard text document. When satisfied with the result, save the output as a TXT file to any folder on your system.

A flexible header option lets you customize what appears at the top of each extracted text block. Choose from none, filename, directory, or full path to easily organize and identify content when converting multiple files in a single session.

Whether you need a simple PDF text extractor, an offline PDF converter, or a batch PDF-to-TXT tool, this utility delivers a straightforward, privacy-friendly solution without the complexity of bloated PDF software.
en-US.name: Vovsoft PDF to Text Converter
